text:
Sarah R: @support Customer (acct: acme-corp, org_id: org_4G7) reports that their rerank calls started failing overnight with a `ModelDeprecated`/410 error. They say the same client code worked last week.

Sarah R: Error payload they pasted:
```json
{
  "error": "ModelDeprecated",
  "message": "model_id 'rerank-legacy-202' has been deprecated and removed",
  "code": 410
}
```

Sarah R: Example request (copied from customer):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model_id":"rerank-legacy-202","query":"best h2o filter","documents":["doc1","doc2","doc3"]}'
```

Sarah R: They also say scores are weird when they get a response (some calls return 200 with extremely low scores). Asking: was this model removed, remapped, or is this a client formatting issue?  Customer is on a paid Dedicated plan and needs a 48h mitigation window while they upgrade.

Luis M: Thanks Sarah. Can you grab the request_id from the customer's failing call (should be in response headers: x-request-id) and a full raw response? Also which region are they hitting? I want to check routing and whether we have a temporary fallback in place.

Sarah R: Provided request_id: `01F8ZKJ7G3P9X2MZQ0` and region: us-west-2. Raw response above is what they pasted. I'm attaching the platform logs from our gateway for that request (redacted):

```text
2026-03-14T22:07:31.123Z gateway INFO req=01F8ZKJ7G3P9X2MZQ0 path=/v1/rerank model_id=rerank-legacy-202 status=410 message=ModelDeprecated
2026-03-14T22:07:31.125Z runtime ERROR req=01F8ZKJ7G3P9X2MZQ0 ModelNotFoundError: model 'rerank-legacy-202' not found in catalog
    at catalog.lookup (/srv/runtime/catalog.js:214)
    at Router.route (/srv/runtime/router.js:98)
```

Ajay (eng-runtime): That log lines up with a catalog removal — looks like `rerank-legacy-202` was removed from the catalog. We deprecated that family last year and scheduled full removal when usage dropped below threshold. Usually we have an alias mapping (legacy -> latest) but I see no mapping for this id in us-west-2.

Ajay (eng-runtime): Two immediate questions: 1) Do you want a temporary mapping for acme-corp only? 2) Do they have any custom rerank preprocessing that would break on the newer model? If they pass custom score scaling we should verify.

Sarah R: Customer says no custom preprocessing, it's pretty vanilla. They asked for a hotfix mapping while they test.

Olivia (oncall): I can create a scoped routing mapping to point `rerank-legacy-202` -> `rerank-v2` for the acme-corp org for 48 hours. That will preserve the API surface while they update. I'll also enable verbose scoring output so they can compare. Example mapping I will apply: 
```json
POST /admin/routing/mappings
{
  "source_model_id": "rerank-legacy-202",
  "target_model_id": "rerank-v2",
  "scope": "org:org_4G7",
  "ttl": "48h",
  "reason": "temporary customer mitigation - acme-corp"
}
```

Olivia (oncall): Pushing now... :hammer_and_wrench:

support-bot: Created incident INC-1982 and pinged eng-runtime. Link: https://redwood.at/b/INC-1982 :eyes:

Olivia (oncall): Mapping applied and propagated to us-west-2. I also enabled `verbose_rerank_scores=true` for that org so the customer can see per-document features/scores for comparison.

Sarah R: Customer confirmed they can now get 200 responses and scores look reasonable. They will schedule a migration by EOD tomorrow. They're happy with the temporary mapping.

Ajay (eng-runtime): Follow-ups for engineering: we should check why alias mappings were not created for this retired model family. Possibly the cleanup job removed catalog entries but missed creating redirect mappings. I'll file a follow-up to add a safety policy: if a model family is removed and there are active orgs still calling it, auto-create a 7-day redirect to the most-compatible model. Filing: ENG-PLT-1487.

Luis M: I'll update the support ticket with repro steps and the mitigation we applied. Also updating docs to call out that some legacy rerank ids were fully removed on 2026-03-01 and clients must move to `rerank-v2` or `rerank-v3`.

Sarah R: Customer will test for 24h and then we can remove the mapping. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

support-bot: INC-1982 status -> resolved. Note: temporary mapping removed after TTL.

Olivia (oncall): Note for ops - we allowed scoped mapping only for dedicated/enterprise customers; do not enable global redirects without a release note to prevent silent behavior changes for self-serve customers.

Sarah R: Closing thread after follow-up email with customer and doc links.
